title: Prove partial capture preserves the paid profile
body:
## Summary

- Construct the partial sum capture left open by PR4061: share helpers 600/601 for consumers 175/183 while retaining consumers 123/202.
- Verify arbitrary dirty inputs and exact cleanup. After cancelling two adjacent inverse shears, the complete recursive profile, helper widths and scalar count are unchanged.
- Prove a sharp four-rank-one-child floor for monotone rewrites with these six physical block endpoints. The original block already attains it.

## Scope and limits

Two frozen PR3945 words retained by PR4061. The finite whole-word checks cover all 723 data, helper and private-buffer coordinates over dyadic free-operator algebra; the separate written floor fixes the block boundaries and single-register child interface. Changed boundaries, surrounding retiming, storage and joint-child interfaces remain open.

The larger-kappa target was not achieved. No new supplier, owner allocation, physical/native-phase/precision/tape/all-size admission, formal-kernel theorem or selected-frontier improvement is established. Separate AI mathematical review is not independent human review.

## Test plan

Tested commit: `c8d11b68d86b091c44629813f788234c154e489a`, CPython 3.12.12.

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/partial-helper-capture` — four public normal/optimized commands; full dirty forward/inverse-transpose/reverse maps, literal/cancelled cleanup, complete frame invoice, independent matrix/row-basis check and rejection controls.
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/partial-helper-capture --check-source-history` — all 23 committed files and canonical/source-freeze ancestry. Original source bytes also match all nine declared public Git blobs.
- [x] Official export/integrity and all four unchanged public commands in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH/PYTHONPATH; all 24 exported files retain bytes, modes and inodes. Every mathematical checker is public; checkpoint/export orchestration receipts are local-only.
- [ ] Hosted CI — natural [run 39326767433](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39326767433) is in progress on this exact head at the latest readback. No rerun or dispatch requested.
- [ ] Independent human review — not observed.

Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo)/[PR4061](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4061) supplies the question and exact frozen inputs; Dugongue/3945 supplies the words, retained through Chris R/Clear1nsight/4045. Tekalign/4048 supplies the capture idea. Rohan Arun/4076 retains Sagar Thakrar's 3687 audit core and Arham Tahir's contract lineage. Exact original heads/paths are in `SOURCE-EXPORT.json`; canonical base `bb4bccbf`, priority 6, and source-only publication ancestry are separately pinned.
